packageRules.description: One weekly MR for all minor and patch updates
Major updates stay separate and are reviewed one by one
OpenSpec 1.14.1 promotes long-requirement diagnostics to WARNING, failing strict spec:check for 117 of 182 items on 2026-10-09 (TASK-359)

pg_dump/pg_restore 18.6 and 17.11 emit transaction_timeout unsupported by the retained PostgreSQL 15 target; 16.15 passes the real backup/restore roundtrip (isolated synthetic proof 2026-10-09, TASK-359)

PostgreSQL 18.6 rejects PostgreSQL 15 data files; 15.19 on Trixie preserves the fixture and starts successfully. Retain the storage major only for existing local/Helm volumes until migration (isolated synthetic proof 2026-10-09, TASK-359)
xmldom 0.9.12 rejects the errorHandler object passed by node-saml 5.1; SAML getSignedAssertion fails, while latest compatible 0.8.15 passes (TASK-359)
minimatch 3.1.5 requires the callable brace-expansion 1.x export; forcing 5.0.12 fails with expand is not a function. Keep latest compatible 1.1.21 only on the legacy edge (TASK-359)
Vite 8.3.4 breaks Vitest 5.0.3 async rejection and snapshot context on Node 26.11.1 and 26.10.0; 8.3.3 passes all 27 unchanged control cases between two failed 8.3.4 runs (TASK-359, 2026-10-09)
